name: addressing-no-interrupt
_provenance: Johnny-trt.48 — the repeatable regression for the trt.46 multi-agent foundation. Two agents are asked back to back, each addressed by name. Under the strict v1 loop rule both agents answer each ask (the always-speak stub router mirrors the worst case); the assertions are the trt.46 invariants: floor holds never overlap, audio stays inside the speaker's own holds, and the co-agent's speech is peer-labeled, never a turn. Johnny-trt.47 (turn claims + router selectivity) tunes against this same fixture: addressed_to is the per-step expectation it flips on — exactly the named agent should answer, the other should record a lost claim or a decline.
